author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

In order to move forward with the RNTuple validation via RelVals (https://gitlab.cern.ch/cms-ppd/monitoring-operation/special-relvals-requests/-/work_items/313) this PR suggests to use the usual `.root` file extension instead of the "special" `.rntpl` used so far in `runTheMatrix.py` + ConfigBuilder (following the discussion on the topic in O&C week).

In order to use `EmbeddedRNtupleTempSource` for RNTuple pileup files, a `--pileup_filetype` command line argument is added to ConfigBuilder, mirroring the behavior of `--filetype`.

In order to test the impact of these changes the special PU workflows are enabled (they were disabled in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50954).

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2470

#### PR validation:

The added workflows run. I also inspected the generated configuration of `38634.0` and `38634.999` and the RNTuple IO components are used as expected.
title: Enable special Phase2 PU workflows, and use `.root` file extension for RNTuple
